fit.checked: The Cartographer, this P23 and its screws against each other and the whole revision-41 carriage (core with P01-P03 and magnets, servo, P20-P22, P24, EBB42, all fasteners); the probe cable is left out, as the Cartographer's own is not modelled.

keepouts.note: The Cartographer's zones come from its own model (solids 100 and 101). Metal of ours fails the check; the core's and the hotends' is existing design, recorded here and not changed.

frame_source.note: Nominal frame, panels and door from 01_Voron24_350_Frame_and_Enclosure as world bounding boxes (conservative for the extrusion profiles). No Z drives, bed supports or bed wiring are modeled.

hardware.cartographer: 2x M3x5 low-profile socket heads (head 5.5 x 1.5) through the Cartographer's board and this P23 into the same 2x M3 x 3 mm inserts in P22. An M3x6 would end 0.07 mm short of the insert hole's end.
hardware.p23_to_p22: Unchanged: 2x M3x4 ISO 7380 button heads on the rear ears into P22's inserts.

limitations: Rigid CAD and sampled straight paths. Insert pull-out, P23 creep under the probe clamp and the probe's electrical behaviour are not qualified.

The Cartographer's keepouts are its model's own zones. The metal recorded in them belongs to the Monolith core and the Red Lizard hotend, is existing design and is not changed; its effect on readings is not qualified.
The Cartographer's own cable route is not modelled; the Beacon's cable route stands in for it in the requalification and is left out of the fit and keepout checks.
